$comment: Username (handle) rules, docs/usernames.md layer 2. The skeleton is normalize(handle) with separators removed; two handles with the same skeleton cannot both exist. ASCII-explicit pattern, portable to ICU, java.util.regex and V8. ownerMinLength: a handle shorter than minLength is valid only when it is a key of handles in reserved-name-owners.json (ADR 0065).

suggestions.$comment: Escolha seu @ (bipe-chat/bipe#200): handleSuggestions(displayName) gives up to candidates handles of the right shape, in order; the app checks availability in that order and shows the first shown that are free. Rule and order: tools/lib/registries.mjs handleSuggestions, test-vectors/handle-suggestions.json.
